_meta.description: PC code map of the Mercenaries 2 Population/Spawner system (PgSysPopulation, scoreboard row 24), married Xbox->PC. PC retail strips all PgSysPopulation:: profiler strings, so runtime bodies are paired structurally (shared magic constants, message-type switches, Lua binding tables). Companion doc: docs/reverse_engineer/population_spawner_code_map.md.

Lua cfuncs recovered by walking the Ai/Pg .rdata binding tables in the unpacked exe (validated vs Pg.Spawn=0x5D5D20). Confidence: high = coincidence-proof fingerprint (matching magic/msg-switch + role); med = role + call-position + one signal; low = positional/among-siblings, confirm-live.
